claim_boundary: Toy storyworld evidence, gate, adaptation, and fallback interactions; not general alignment, neural AIRIS performance, or production robustness.

headline_exposed_probe.definition: Evasion requires exposed pass rate to rise while exact soundness and hidden-audit performance do not; fixed-probe collapse is reported separately as aging.

oversight_leverage.oracle_caveat: Oracle value is available in this finite gym only; deployment requires a shadow-audit proxy.
